notes.title: Adding reverb effect options to game audio.
notes.content: In the main menu, select ‘SOUND’ and toggle between ‘REVERB OFF’ and ‘REVERB ON‘

notes.title: Camera zooming/vibrating option updated.
notes.content:
Camera effects options related to zooming and vibration have been added.
OTHER -> CAMERA ZOOMING :STRONG /WEAK /NONE
OTHER -> CAMERA VIBRATION :STRONG /WEAK /NONE

notes.title: Camera zooming option
notes.content:
I have added an option to turn off camera zoom for game effects.
(OTHER -> CAMERA ZOOMING ON/OFF)

notes.title: An extraordinary feature "PUNEKROYER" added.
notes.content: PUNEKROYER is a function that allows you to display images or other files as the background in a game. You can now enjoy Uki Uki Heaven 2 while listening to your favorite music, displaying a slideshow of your own photos, or watching videos.

notes.title: Various improvements
notes.content:
Changes to ningen melee weapons.
Changed behavior of stage 1 boss.
etc.

notes.title: Suppression of excessive special effects and camerawork.
notes.content: I have improved the poor visibility of the game screen.

notes.title: Leaderboard Added
notes.content: You can check the global ranking of your high score now.

notes.title: Stage attack mode
notes.content:
"Stage attack mode" and 6 Steam achievements have been added.
To unlock them you need to fulfill certain requirements in HARD mode.

notes.title: Update 11/21/2023.
notes.content: v313: Various improvements. Guide book page added.
